info.title: They Said So Quotes API

requests.description: Gets `Quote of the Day`. Optional `category` param determines the category of returned quote of the day
requests.name: GET /qod

requests.description: Gets a list of `Quote of the Day` Categories.
requests.name: GET /qod/categories

requests.description: Gets a list of supported languages for `Quote of the Day`.
requests.name: GET /qod/languages

requests.description: Delete a qshow.
requests.name: DELETE /qshow

requests.description: Gets a details about a qshow.
requests.name: GET /qshow

requests.description: Update an existing qshow.
requests.name: PATCH /qshow

requests.description: Create and add a new qshow to your private collection.
requests.name: PUT /qshow

requests.description: Get the list of Qshows in They Said So platform.
requests.name: GET /qshow/list

requests.description: Get the quotes in a given Qshow.
requests.name: GET /qshow/quotes

requests.description: Add a quote to a given Qshow.

requests.description: Remove a quote to a given Qshow.

requests.description: Delete a quote. The user needs to be the owner of the quote to be able to delete it.
requests.name: DELETE /quote

requests.description: Gets a `Quote` with a given `id`.
requests.name: GET /quote

requests.description: Update a quote
requests.name: PATCH /quote

requests.description: Add a new quote to your private collection. Same as 'PUT' but added since some clients don't handle PUT well.
requests.name: POST /quote

requests.description: Add a new quote to your private collection.
requests.name: PUT /quote

requests.description: Gets a list of popular author names in the system.
requests.name: GET /quote/authors/popular

requests.description: Gets a list of author names in the system.
requests.name: GET /quote/authors/search

requests.description: Gets a list of popular `Quote` Categories.
requests.name: GET /quote/categories/popular

requests.description: Gets a list of `Quote` Categories matching the query string.
requests.name: GET /quote/categories/search

requests.description: Remove the disLike for the given Quote as a user of the API Key.
requests.name: DELETE /quote/dislike

requests.description: Dislike the given Quote as a user of the API Key. Same as `put` but a convenient alias for those clients that don't support `put` cleanly.
requests.name: POST /quote/dislike

requests.description: Dislike the given Quote as a user of the API Key. Some clients don't cleanly support `PUT`, in such scenarios use the `POST` version of this.
requests.name: PUT /quote/dislike

requests.description: Delete a quote image. The user needs to be the owner of the quote image to be able to delete it.
requests.name: DELETE /quote/image

requests.description: Gets a Quote image for a given id. Response can be an image file as a binary or a base64 encoded contents wrapped in json. `TODO`
requests.name: GET /quote/image

requests.description: Create a new quote image for a given quote. Choose background colors/images , choose different font styles and generate a beautiful quote image. Did you just had a feeling of being a god or what?!
requests.name: PUT /quote/image

requests.description: Delete a background image file. The user needs to be the owner of the background image to be able to delete it.
requests.name: DELETE /quote/image/background

requests.description: Add an image for use later as a quote background image.
requests.name: POST /quote/image/background

requests.description: Lists background images in your private collection.
requests.name: GET /quote/image/background/list

requests.description: Searches for a background image with a given tag.
requests.name: GET /quote/image/background/search

requests.description: Add a tag to a given Image.
requests.name: POST /quote/image/background/tags/add

requests.description: Remove a tag from a given Image.
requests.name: POST /quote/image/background/tags/remove

requests.description: Delete a font file. The user needs to be the owner of the font to be able to delete it.
requests.name: DELETE /quote/image/font

requests.description: Add a font file for use later in creating a quote image. This is essentially a `PUT` but not many clients handle PUT with binary stream i.e. a file, gracefully.
requests.name: POST /quote/image/font

requests.description: Lists background images in your private collection.
requests.name: GET /quote/image/font/list

requests.description: Searches for a font with a given tag.
requests.name: GET /quote/image/font/search

requests.description: Add a tag to a given font.
requests.name: POST /quote/image/font/tags/add

requests.description: Remove a tag from a given Font.
requests.name: POST /quote/image/font/tags/remove

requests.description: Gets a Random Quote image. Optional `category` param determines the category of quote used in the image. Optional `author` param gets the quote image of a given author.
requests.name: GET /quote/image/search

requests.description: Remove the Like for the given Quote as a user of the API Key.
requests.name: DELETE /quote/like

requests.description: Like the given Quote as a user of the API Key. Same as `PUT` but a convenient alias for those clients that don't support `PUT` cleanly.

requests.name: PUT /quote/like

requests.description: Get the list of quotes in your private collection.
requests.name: GET /quote/list

requests.description: Gets a `Random Quote`. When you are in a hurry this is what you call to get a random famous quote.
requests.name: GET /quote/random

requests.description: Search for a `Quote` in They Said So platform. Optional `category` , `author`, `minlength`, `maxlength` params determines the filters applied while searching for the quote.
requests.name: GET /quote/search
